name: ai-memory
description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
readmeExcerpt: > Long-term memory for AI coding agents. Quit Claude Code mid-task, > start OpenAI Codex in the same directory, continue without > re-explaining the architecture, the failed approaches, or the open > questions. **Website: [aimemory.sh](https://aimemory.sh)** [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/website-aimemory.sh-blue)](https://aimemory.sh) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/akitaonrails/ai-memory)](https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/releases/latest) [![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-1.95+-blue)](rust-toolchain.toml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ## Why ai-memory Your coding agent probably has a memory feature already. Claude Code takes its own notes, Cursor remembers some things, and every platform is adding more. They all have the same limits: the notes live on one machine, belong to one agent, and drop out of view when you switch tools or hand the work to a teammate. ai-memory removes those limits. - **It follows you across agents.** More than twenty harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Grok, Devin, Kimi, Kiro, and others) feed one shared memory. Quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and the next agent picks up a handoff that says where you left off, what failed, and what is still open. Handoffs are a typed protocol: each one has an owner and is claimed exactly once. - **It can carry the session, not just a summary.** Start agents with `ai-memory run`: quit Claude Code, run `ai-memory run codex`, and Codex gets the shared workstream plus a private, temporary local projection of Claude's visible native history for exact details the bounded startup packet omitted. The remote server receives only the harness and session identity, never the local transcript path or body. Direct harness launches behave exactly as before. - **It follows you across projects.** A small profile of how you usually work (your package manager, test layout, architecture habits) reaches every new repository at session start, so you stop re-explaining yourself. It sits below each repository's rules file as a default. It is on by default for a single user, and on a shared server it is opt-in and private per person. See [`docs/cross-project-profile.md`](docs/cross-project-profile.md). - **It follows you across machines.** Memory lives in a server you run, on the same laptop, a homelab box, or anywhere else, so the project you left on the desktop is the project you resume on the laptop, with the same knowledge and the same open questions. - **It works for a team.** Point everyone at one server, and what one person's sessions learn, everyone's agents can retrieve. analysis.oneLine: ai-memory 是一个面向 AI Agent 的记忆管理组件，适合用于为智能体应用提供上下文记忆、长期状态和可复用会话能力。
analysis.problem: 多数 Agent Demo 只能完成单轮任务，缺少可控、可追踪、可迁移的长期记忆层
analysis.audience: AI 应用开发者、Agent 工作流团队、需要构建长期上下文能力的小型产品团队
detailParagraphs: ai-memory 更准确地说是一个面向 AI Agent 的记忆管理组件，而不是一个只因为短期热度上榜的仓库。对国内用户来说，判断重点不应停留在 README 的自我描述，而要看它是否能解决一个真实、可复用、可持续维护的工作流问题：多数 Agent Demo 只能完成单轮任务，缺少可控、可追踪、可迁移的长期记忆层。
如果把它放进实际使用场景，ai-memory 的价值主要来自为智能体应用提供上下文记忆、长期状态和可复用会话能力。当前 Star 约 13,057，说明它已经具备一定社区关注度，但商业用户更需要继续验证三件事：是否能嵌入现有业务流程，是否能由团队基于 Rust 技术栈持续维护，以及是否能形成稳定交付而不是一次性 Demo。

从商业化和私有化角度看，如果接口清晰、存储可控，它可以成为 Agent 产品中的基础组件，而不是终端应用；商业复用重点在稳定性、可观测性和与现有数据系统的集成。需要核对数据库、向量存储、鉴权、清理策略和数据隔离能力，尤其要关注企业客户对隐私和审计的要求。当前最需要警惕的是：风险在于记忆质量难评估、数据越权风险高、不同模型和工作流下效果波动较大。因此建议先用一个小范围真实任务做部署测试，再决定它适合作为内部工具、客户方案组件，还是仅作为趋势观察样本。
scenarios: 客服 Agent 长期上下文
个人 AI 助手记忆层
企业知识工作流状态管理
analysis.interpretation: ai-memory 的评估重点是产品形态、工程成熟度和场景适配，而不是 README 文案本身。对付费信息服务用户来说，它的价值在于帮助快速判断是否值得投入一次部署验证、是否有二次开发空间、是否能成为降本增效工具或商业服务组件。
analysis.installRequirements: 通常需要 Rust 相关运行环境，具体版本以官方 README 为准。
analysis.installGuide:
git clone https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory
docker run -d --name ai-memory \
docker.io/akitaonrails/ai-memory:latest
analysis.deployment: 具备 Docker 线索，可能适合容器化部署，但仍需核对镜像、数据目录和配置项。
analysis.commercialValue: 如果接口清晰、存储可控，它可以成为 Agent 产品中的基础组件，而不是终端应用；商业复用重点在稳定性、可观测性和与现有数据系统的集成；由于关注度较高，适合作为竞品研究、工具选型或方案组件候选。
analysis.efficiencyValue: 如果项目与现有工作流匹配，效率价值主要体现在为智能体应用提供上下文记忆、长期状态和可复用会话能力，并减少从零选型和重复开发的时间。
analysis.learningValue: 适合学习以 Rust 为主的技术栈下同类项目的产品组织、工程结构、README 表达和社区反馈。
analysis.reuseValue: 具备二次开发可能，但需要结合许可证、代码结构、依赖复杂度、接口稳定性和维护节奏判断。
analysis.chinaNotes: 国内使用时要重点检查 GitHub、镜像源、模型服务、第三方 API 和 Docker 镜像访问稳定性。
analysis.risk: 风险在于记忆质量难评估、数据越权风险高、不同模型和工作流下效果波动较大。
